headline: ICTSI shares fall 6.5% despite positive Q3 net income growth
summary: Shares of International Container Terminal Services Inc. fell 6.5% over the week despite solid Q3 earnings growth, as investors engaged in profit-taking over growth sustainability concerns.
why: ICTSI is the Philippines' largest global port operator with extensive terminal concessions across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

impacts.name: ICTSI
impacts.why: Profit-taking weighed on ICTSI share price despite reported third-quarter revenue growth.
